title: Count one invoice against GitHub's record, in a repository you own
statement:
Test USDC, no monetary value.

Run `knos shadow` on agent pull requests of a repository you own and publish the statement it writes.
evidence: a published statement (knos.shadow) whose repository's owner is your account, with at least one line and its digest
counted_when: the account that did it is not one of Knos's own (scripts/own_github_ids.json); shown as "on tasks Knos funded itself"
